page.overview:
Who is Bosch?

Bosch is brash in nature and willing to rush into battle without a second thought, but like the Avatar, he is driven to find the meaning of strength. He detests evil and wants to kill JP for what he did to Nayshall, and later recognizes the Avatar as a close friend for saving him from being brainwashed by Psycho Power.

After being abducted by Neo Shadaloo, Bosch loses all of his traditional Nayshall attire, instead going shirtless with a torn green jumpsuit numbered '064' with the sleeves tied around his waist, uneven bandages up his arms and covering his feet, a single studded leather pauldron on his left shoulder, and large metal cuffs with chains around both wrists. The pauldron seems to be a restraint as well, as the strap around his bicep appears to be metal and secured by a bolt. He no longer wears his braids, and his hair has a slightly more wild look to it, showing both eyes when not wearing a paint-splattered cardboard box, also numbered '064.' Most notably, he has gained several scars, the largest being the giant X-shaped one across his chest. All his scars glow purple, and appear to be festering with Psycho Power even when Bosch has a grip on himself.

As Luke's student, Bosch's fighting style is largely based off of his master's, though he has several original techniques used in his encounters in World Tour mode. The first of these is , an uppercut delivered with his elbow.

Bosch uses several more original techniques as the Cardboard Combatant after being infused with Psycho Power. These include , a sphere-shaped projectile of Psycho Power that hits three times, , a stronger Psycho Power-infused version of Crazed Blade that is followed by a move similar to Luke's Slam Dunk, , a move in which he winds up and charges at the opponent with a rapid punch, , a shoulder bash that serves as Bosch's Drive Impact, and , Bosch's exclusive Super Art that consists of a lunging punch followed by two scratch attacks, a low roundhouse kick, finishing with a vertical rotating kick.
